aegis_insights.title: Revenue is structurally concentrated — 75.2% in one Channel segment
aegis_insights.fact: 'LinkedIn Ads' accounts for 75.2% of total Revenue across 4 Channel segments. Top 3 segments collectively: 97.7%. HHI concentration index: 0.596.
aegis_insights.pattern: Structural concentration: 75.2% of Revenue is held by a single segment out of 4. This creates a single point of dependency for Revenue. HHI of 0.596 confirms the distribution is far from uniform.
aegis_insights.impact: A 24.8% reduction in the contribution of 'LinkedIn Ads' would eliminate most of the dataset's Revenue. With 4 segments and 75.2% in one, diversification is critically low — any structural shift in 'LinkedIn Ads' propagates with full magnitude to Revenue totals.

aegis_insights.title: Ad_Spend trending upward while Conversions declines — structural tension detected
aegis_insights.fact: Ad_Spend is on a validated UPWARD trajectory. Conversions is on a validated DOWNWARD trajectory. Both passed directional correctness validation.
aegis_insights.pattern: These two metrics are moving in structurally opposing directions across the full dataset. This is a global pattern — not isolated to any single segment — confirmed by independent signal analysis.
aegis_insights.impact: Opposing movements between Ad_Spend (+trend, 46.9% confidence) and Conversions (-trend, 46.9% confidence) create structural tension: gains in one metric coincide with losses in the other. This constrains total upside — improvement in both directions simultaneously is not consistent with the observed data.
